generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Terrms and Conditions applies as per Tender Notification and KW-04

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-2026) (a) Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs. 2108.65 Lakhs

ITT 3.2 - To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-2026) (b) Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work such as all classes of civil engineering construction works (which may include all railway barricade works carried out in one financial year) of value not less than Rs. 527.16 lakhs.

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate (a) Availability of the required key and critical equipment for this work for all works provided, the relevant documents (make, year of manufacture, capacity & working conditions of each equipment along with other documents etc.,) shall be furnished. ITT 3.3 - Each Tenderer should further demonstrate

Each Tenderer should further demonstrate: (b) Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs 316.30 Lakhs (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.)
Registration Certificate- Tenderer should be registered with: (i) KPWD Class 1
Total Value of works executed and payments received in the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26
Work performed as Prime Contractor (in the same name) on works of similar nature during the last five years specified in 1.2 above

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Construction of Elephant Proof Barricading using used Rails at Along the Boundary of Anchethittu Garekatte to Jojo Thomas house, Gattadalla Beat, Maldare Section in Kushalnagar Range

itemList.description: Item Description: Procurement of used ralls from railway department including material cost etc., complete

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: 1.No-2.5, Pg.No-9 PWD SR VOL-3 2023-24
itemList.description: Item Description: Clearing and grubbing road land Including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, Including removal and disposal of top organic soll not exceeding 150 mm In thickness.

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: I.No-1.14.1, Pg.No-8 PWD SR VOL-1 2023-
itemList.description: Item Description: Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, Including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: I.No-2.1.3, Pg.No-15 PWD SR VOL-1 2023-
itemList.description: Item Description: Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in Foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, Including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: I.No-2.2.1, Pg.No-15 PWD SR VOL-1 2023-
itemList.description: Item Description: Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - M 20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates for Vertical Rails

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: I.No-2.2.1, Pg.No-15 PWD SR VOL-1 2023-
itemList.description: Item Description: Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers lald In finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, Including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates for Special Structure, At gates, Pipe Culverts - Head Walls, Parapet

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: 1.No-2.3.1, Pg.No-16 PWD SR VOL-1 2023-
itemList.description: Item Description: Providing and laying in Cement Concrete for all Basement & surface level works, return walls, retalning walls, sunken floors etc. The granite/trap/ basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: 1.No-2.3.1, Pg.No-16 PWD SR VOL-1 2023-
itemList.description: Item Description: Providing and laying in Cement Concrete for all Basement & surface level works. retum walls, retaining walls, sunken floors etc. The granite/trap/ basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, Including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates
Item Description: Transportation of used ralls from railway yard to the stock yard Including loading. transportation and unloading charges etc., complete

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: 1.No-2.11-h, Pg.No-18 PWD SR VOL-1 2023
itemList.description: Item Description: Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550/550D Steel Reinforcement Including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/velding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other tune of siniclures

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: Quantity as per vide item no. 8
itemList.description: Item Description: Fabrication and erection of rails including cutting of rails into suitable lengths, making holes using drill bits for fixing of anchor rods, horizontal rails to vertical ralls including fixing of nuts and bolts in position as per drawing complete etc., Rate includes transportation of material from stock yard to work site. (Data Rate)

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: 1.No-11.22, Pg.No-82 PWD SR VOL-2 2023-
itemList.description: Item Description: Welding by gas or electric plant including transportation of plant at site etc. complete Including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-In-Charge

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: 1.No-1.9, Pg.No-7 PWD SR VOL-1 2023-24
itemList.description: Item Description: Filling avaliable excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.

itemList.itemCode: Item Code: 1.No-8.58-b, Pg.No-80 PWD SR VOL-3 2023
itemList.description: Item Description: Providing and laying Rainforced Cement Concrete pipe light duty NP2 for culverts, roadway utilities& crossingsas per IS 458:2003 in Single row including pointing ends and fixing collars with cement mortar 1:2 including cost of all materials, labour, curing completess per specifications. 450 mm diz
